title: Prism Match
logline: Rotate colorful prisms on a grid to direct light beams to their matching receptors — a serene yet increasingly devious puzzle of optics and color.
visualStyle: Clean minimalist dark background (#0a0a2e). Grid cells are subtle outlined squares. Prisms are bright geometric triangles in 4 colors (red, blue, green, yellow). Light beams are animated dashed lines with glow effect. Receptors pulse gently when awaiting their beam. Completed connections create a satisfying full-glow state.
coreMechanic: A grid (starting 5x5) contains prisms and receptors. Click a prism to rotate it 90° clockwise. Each prism reflects incoming light beams at 90° angles. Light sources emit beams from grid edges. Rotate all prisms so every beam reaches its matching-color receptor. Timer counts up (speed-run). Moves counter tracks efficiency.
progression: Levels 1-3: Single color, small grid. Levels 4-6: Two colors, larger grid. Levels 7-10: Three colors, beam splitters. Levels 11+: Four colors, mirrors, walls. Procedural generation after level 15.
scoring: Base 1000/level. -10/move (min 100). -1/second. Bonus 500 under par moves, 300 under par time. Star rating 3/2/1.
gameOverCondition: Level-based — run ends when player quits or fails 5min timeout. Cumulative score.
restartBehavior: Level 1, score 0. Or restart current level only.

screens.intro: PRISM MATCH with animated light beams crossing. Prism shapes rotate in background. Click to Start. Highest level reached.
screens.hud: Level top-left, Moves top-center, Timer top-right, Stars, R to Reset hint.
screens.pause: PAUSED, level + cumulative score, Click to Resume.
screens.gameOver: COMPLETE or TIME'S UP. Levels, score, stars. Play Again.
